source: 롤링 업데이트 환경에서 전투 데이터가 분리되어 맹약 등 전투 효과가 적용되지 않던 문제를 수정했습니다.
before: Fixed an issue where combat data was separated in the rolling update environment and combat effects such as oaths were not applied.
after: Fixed an issue where combat data was separated in the rolling update environment and combat effects such as Alliances were not applied.

source: 신규 아군·적 증강을 추가하고 효과에 맞는 위기협약 및 맹약 아이콘을 적용했습니다. 조화 증강은 조화를 활성화하며 기본 조화 규칙이 켜진 게임에서는 등장하지 않습니다.
before: New ally and enemy reinforcements have been added, and crisis pact and oath icons have been applied to match the effect. Harmony Augments activate Harmony and do not appear in games with the default Harmony rules turned on.
after: New ally and enemy Augments have been added, and crisis Alliance and Alliance icons have been applied to match the effect. Harmony Augments activate Harmony and do not appear in games with the default Harmony rules turned on.

source: 맹약 증강에 해당 맹약 아이콘을 적용하고 조화 지원 증강을 제외했습니다. 장비 지원 설명에 지급 장비 이름과 수량을 표시합니다. 영광스러운 진화와 대마법사를 각각 이샤믈라의 축복과 아츠 마스터로 변경했습니다.
before: The corresponding covenant icon has been applied to the covenant augmentation, and the harmony support augmentation has been excluded. Display the name and quantity of the equipment issued in the equipment support description. Changed Glorious Evolution and Archmage to Blessing of Ishamla and Arts Master respectively.
after: The corresponding Alliance icon has been applied to the Alliance Augment, and the harmony support Augment has been excluded. Display the name and quantity of the equipment issued in the equipment support description. Changed Glorious Evolution and Archmage to Blessing of Ishamla and Arts Master respectively.

source: 8인 협력방어 개별 관전 시 관전 대상의 맹약을 표시합니다.
before: When spectating individually in 8-person cooperative defense, the oath of the spectating target is displayed.
after: When spectating individually in 8-person cooperative defense, the Alliance of the spectating target is displayed.

source: 8인 모드는 맹약·오퍼레이터 밴이 없으며, 오퍼레이터 밴 제외 설정을 제거했습니다.
before: There is no covenant/operator ban in 8-player mode, and the operator ban exclusion setting has been removed.
after: There is no Alliance/operator ban in 8-player mode, and the operator ban exclusion setting has been removed.

source: 전투 중과 종료 안내에 재시작 버튼을 추가했습니다. 전투 시작 전 배치·장비·맹약 중첩으로 돌아가 다시 준비할 수 있습니다.
before: A restart button has been added to notifications during and after battle. Before the battle begins, you can return to deployment, equipment, and covenant stacking to prepare again.
after: A restart button has been added to notifications during and after battle. Before the battle begins, you can return to deployment, equipment, and Alliance stacking to prepare again.

source: 에벤홀츠 특질은 라이타니엔 3중첩당 공격력 일반 +2%·승급 +4%입니다. 비비아나는 5단계이며 카시미어 맹약을 추가했습니다. 디아만테의 이름을 정정하고 특질 발동 한도를 전투당 5회로 변경했습니다.
before: Ebenholtz's trait is general attack power +2% and promotion +4% per 3 stacks of Laitanien. Bibiana is level 5 and has added the Casimir Covenant. Diamante's name has been corrected and the talent activation limit has been changed to 5 per battle.
after: Ebenholtz's trait is general attack power +2% and promotion +4% per 3 stacks of Laitanien. Bibiana is level 5 and has added the Casimir Alliance. Diamante's name has been corrected and the talent activation limit has been changed to 5 per battle.

source: 속세의 음의 별도 피해 증가 효과를 제거하고 매초 피해를 시전자 공격력의 5% + 맹약 중첩당 0.015%로 변경했습니다.
before: Removed the separate Voice of Mundane damage bonus. Damage per second is now 5% of the caster's ATK + 0.015% per Bond stack.
after: Removed the separate Voice of Mundane damage bonus. Damage per second is now 5% of the caster's ATK + 0.015% per Alliance stack.

source: 변경된 맹약·특질·전략 설명을 기존 문체에 맞춰 정리했습니다.
before: The changed oath, trait, and strategy descriptions have been organized to match the existing writing style.
after: The changed Alliance, trait, and strategy descriptions have been organized to match the existing writing style.

source: 상점 재고·맹약 중첩 상한선 해제, 조화 기본 활성화, 아군 HP 공유 규칙을 추가했습니다.
before: The store inventory/covenant stack cap has been lifted, basic harmony has been activated, and ally HP sharing rules have been added.
after: The store inventory/Alliance stack cap has been lifted, basic harmony has been activated, and ally HP sharing rules have been added.

source: 커스텀 설정에서 선택할 때만 라이타니엔 맹약·오퍼레이터 8명·장비 2종·에벤홀츠의 맹세·위치킹 전략을 추가합니다. 카넬리안과 에이야퍄들라 더 크비트 아스카에도 맹약을 추가하며 커스텀 핵심 맹약당 밴 수 +1 규칙을 유지합니다.
before: The Laitanien Oath, 8 operators, 2 types of equipment, Ebenholtz's Oath, and Witch King strategy are added only when selected in the custom settings. Covenants are also added to Carnelian and Eyjafjalla the Kvit Asuka, and the custom core covenant +1 ban rule is maintained.
after: The Laitanien Alliance, 8 operators, 2 types of equipment, Ebenholtz's Alliance, and Witch King strategy are added only when selected in the custom settings. Alliances are also added to Carnelian and Eyjafjalla the Kvit Asuka, and the custom core Alliance +1 ban rule is maintained.

source: 에벤홀츠 특질은 3중첩당 공격력 일반 +1%·승급 +2%, 디아만테는 라이타니엔/아케인 맹약과 쇠약 손상 부여 시 중첩 획득, 에이야퍄들라는 라이타니엔/신속 일반 +3/+2·승급 +6/+4로 조정했습니다. 비비아나는 기존 중첩 획득 특질과 전투당 최대 10회 제한을 유지합니다. 비비아나는 6단계, 에벤홀츠는 5단계로 변경했습니다.
before: Ebenholtz's trait was adjusted to general attack power +1% and promotion +2% per 3 stacks, Diamante gained stacks when applying Laitanien/Arcane oath and debilitating damage, and Eyjafjäldla to Laitanien/Swift general +3/+2 and promotion +6/+4. Viviana retains the existing stack gain trait and the maximum limit of 10 per battle. Bibiana was changed to level 6, and Ebenholtz was changed to level 5.
after: Ebenholtz's trait was adjusted to general attack power +1% and promotion +2% per 3 stacks, Diamante gained stacks when applying Laitanien/Arcane Alliance and debilitating damage, and Eyjafjäldla to Laitanien/Swift general +3/+2 and promotion +6/+4. Viviana retains the existing stack gain trait and the maximum limit of 10 per battle. Bibiana was changed to level 6, and Ebenholtz was changed to level 5.

source: 체르니 보조맹약을 고수로 수정하고 신규 오퍼레이터의 전투 진입 소실을 수정했습니다. 추가한 오퍼레이터는 선발 목록에서 제외합니다.
before: Changed Cherny's auxiliary oath to expert and fixed the loss of new operators entering battle. The added operator will be excluded from the selection list.
after: Changed Cherny's auxiliary Alliance to expert and fixed the loss of new operators entering battle. The added operator will be excluded from the selection list.

source: 상점 위치에 7칸 페이지형 실험실 메뉴를 배치했습니다. 초성 검색과 탭별 필터 유지를 지원하며 가격, 전투 효과 없는 장비, 중첩 없는 맹약은 표시하지 않습니다.
before: A 7-page laboratory menu has been placed in the store location. It supports initial consonant search and maintains filters by tab, and does not display prices, equipment without combat effects, or oaths without stacks.
after: A 7-page laboratory menu has been placed in the store location. It supports initial consonant search and maintains filters by tab, and does not display prices, equipment without combat effects, or Alliances without stacks.

source: 전투 통계의 컨트롤·요약·그래프 배치를 정리하고, 캐서린 지원 장치를 마름모 프레임 없이 표시합니다. 맹약 중첩 숫자의 줄바꿈과 방 코드의 한글 키 입력을 수정했습니다.
before: The control, summary, and graph layout of battle statistics has been organized, and Catherine's support devices are displayed without diamond frames. Fixed line breaks in oath stack numbers and Korean keystrokes in room codes.
after: The control, summary, and graph layout of battle statistics has been organized, and Catherine's support devices are displayed without diamond frames. Fixed line breaks in Alliance stack numbers and Korean keystrokes in room codes.

source: 오퍼레이터·선발 설정에 세로 목록 보기를 추가했습니다. 한 줄에 단계·직군·맹약·스킬·모듈을 아이콘으로 표시하고, 스킬·모듈·선발 단계를 바로 설정할 수 있습니다.
before: Vertical list view has been added to operator/selection settings. You can display stages, occupations, oaths, skills, and modules as icons in one line, and set the skills, modules, and selection stages right away.
after: Vertical list view has been added to operator/selection settings. You can display stages, occupations, Alliances, skills, and modules as icons in one line, and set the skills, modules, and selection stages right away.

source: 관전 설정의 하단 안내를 제거하고 커스텀 확장 설정을 커스텀 설정으로 변경했습니다. 맹약·맵 목록에서 기존 콘텐츠와 커스텀 콘텐츠를 구분합니다.
before: The bottom guidance in spectating settings has been removed and the custom expansion settings have been changed to custom settings. Distinguish between existing content and custom content in the covenant/map list.
after: The bottom guidance in spectating settings has been removed and the custom expansion settings have been changed to custom settings. Distinguish between existing content and custom content in the Alliance/map list.

source: 우르수스의 체력 증가량을 중첩당 0.5%로 변경했습니다. 이스티나는 우르수스/정밀 맹약으로 변경하고 중첩을 일반 각각 +2·승급 각각 +4 획득합니다.
before: Ursus' health increase has been changed to 0.5% per stack. Istina changes to Ursus/Precision Oath and gains +2 each normal and +4 each promoted.
after: Ursus' health increase has been changed to 0.5% per stack. Istina changes to Ursus/Precision Alliance and gains +2 each normal and +4 each promoted.

source: 맹약 숨김 시 목록 전체를 숨깁니다. 펼치기 버튼은 유지합니다.
before: When hiding an oath, the entire list is hidden. The expand button is retained.
after: When hiding an Alliance, the entire list is hidden. The expand button is retained.

source: 맹약이 12개를 넘으면 11.5개를 표시하고 끝을 그라데이션 처리합니다. 스크롤바 없이 드래그할 수 있으며 숨김 버튼 높이를 줄였습니다.
before: If there are more than 12 oaths, 11.5 are displayed and the ends are gradient-processed. You can now drag without a scroll bar, and the hidden button height has been reduced.
after: If there are more than 12 Alliances, 11.5 are displayed and the ends are gradient-processed. You can now drag without a scroll bar, and the hidden button height has been reduced.

source: 전투 중 맹약 목록을 가로 스크롤·줄바꿈 없이 한 줄로 표시합니다. 중앙 아래 접기 버튼을 누르면 위로 올려 아래쪽 1/3만 투명도 그라데이션으로 남깁니다.
before: During battle, the pledge list is displayed in one line without horizontal scrolling or line breaks. If you press the fold button below the center, it will move up, leaving only the bottom 1/3 as a transparency gradient.
after: During battle, the Alliance list is displayed in one line without horizontal scrolling or line breaks. If you press the fold button below the center, it will move up, leaving only the bottom 1/3 as a transparency gradient.

source: 비헌터를 3단계·중첩 +5, 우쿠시크를 2단계·중첩 +3으로 변경했습니다. 보타니의 신속 맹약과 획득 중첩을 기적으로 변경했습니다.
before: Changed Be-Hunter to level 3 and stacking +5, and Ukusik to level 2 and stacking +3. Changed Botani's Speed ​​Pact and gain stacks to Miracles.
after: Changed Be-Hunter to level 3 and stacking +5, and Ukusik to level 2 and stacking +3. Changed Botani's Speed ​​Alliance and gain stacks to Miracles.

source: 선호 프리셋 목록을 분리하고 맹약·등급 필터를 추가했습니다.
before: Separated the preferred presets list and added pledge/tier filters.
after: Separated the preferred presets list and added Alliance/tier filters.

source: 커스텀 확장에서 핵심 맹약·맵·보스·전략을 금지할 수 있습니다. 게임에 필요한 최소 구성을 유지합니다.
before: You can ban key oaths, maps, bosses, and strategies in custom expansions. Maintain the minimum configuration required for the game.
after: You can ban key Alliances, maps, bosses, and strategies in custom expansions. Maintain the minimum configuration required for the game.

source: 전투 중 맹약 중첩 알림을 효과를 발동한 오퍼레이터 위에 표시합니다.
before: During battle, an oath stack notification will be displayed above the operator who activated the effect.
after: During battle, an Alliance stack notification will be displayed above the operator who activated the effect.

source: 헬라그 특질을 공격속도 증가로 변경하고 불굴 맹약을 추가했습니다.
before: Changed Hellag's trait to increased attack speed and added Indomitable Pact.
after: Changed Hellag's trait to increased attack speed and added Indomitable Alliance.

source: 안내 메시지를 맹약 목록 아래로 옮기고 활성화 단계 표시를 확대했습니다.
before: We have moved the guidance message to the bottom of the pledge list and enlarged the display of activation levels.
after: We have moved the guidance message to the bottom of the Alliance list and enlarged the display of activation levels.

source: 배치 인원이 없는 맹약을 숨기고 10개를 넘는 목록은 가로 스크롤로 표시합니다.
before: Covenants without assigned personnel are hidden and lists of more than 10 are displayed with horizontal scrolling.
after: Alliances without assigned personnel are hidden and lists of more than 10 are displayed with horizontal scrolling.

source: 맹약 목록의 접기 버튼과 중복 관전 표식을 제거했습니다.
before: The collapse button and duplicate spectator symbols in the pledge list have been removed.
after: The collapse button and duplicate spectator symbols in the Alliance list have been removed.

source: 이번 판 정보에 맹약별 밴 목록과 현재 대상의 전략을 표시합니다.
before: This edition's information displays a list of bans for each oath and the current target's strategy.
after: This edition's information displays a list of bans for each Alliance and the current target's strategy.

source: 커스텀 확장 설정에 맹약·전장 탭을 추가했습니다. 여러 확장을 함께 선택할 수 있고 버튼에 적용 개수를 표시합니다.
before: The Oath/Battlefield tab has been added to custom expansion settings. You can select multiple extensions together and the button displays the number of applications.
after: The Alliance/Battlefield tab has been added to custom expansion settings. You can select multiple extensions together and the button displays the number of applications.

source: 우르수스를 비활성화하면 관련 맹약·추가 오퍼레이터를 게임 정보에서 제외하고, 굼·베토치키의 기존 맹약만 표시합니다.
before: If Ursus is disabled, related oaths and additional operators will be excluded from the game information, and only the existing oaths of Gum and Betochki will be displayed.
after: If Ursus is disabled, related Alliances and additional operators will be excluded from the game information, and only the existing Alliances of Gum and Betochki will be displayed.

source: 커스텀 진영 활성화 시 핵심 맹약 밴 수를 늘려 사용 가능한 핵심 맹약이 5개가 되도록 조정했습니다.
before: When activating a custom faction, the number of core covenant bans has been increased so that there are 5 core covenants available.
after: When activating a custom faction, the number of core Alliance bans has been increased so that there are 5 core Alliances available.

source: 에기르·조화 맹약 효과를 순차 배치 완료 후 계산하도록 보완했습니다.
before: The effects of Aegir and Harmony Pact have been supplemented to be calculated after sequential placement is completed.
after: The effects of Aegir and Harmony Alliance have been supplemented to be calculated after sequential placement is completed.

source: 우르수스 커스텀 맹약과 오퍼레이터 8명, 제국 드론, 전용 장비와 카셰이 전략을 추가했습니다. 굼·베토치키도 우르수스에 포함됩니다.
before: Added Ursus Custom Covenant, 8 Operators, Imperial Drone, exclusive equipment, and Kashay Strategy. Gum and Betochiki are also included in Ursus.
after: Added Ursus Custom Alliance, 8 Operators, Imperial Drone, exclusive equipment, and Kashay Strategy. Gum and Betochiki are also included in Ursus.

after: The chess piece requires at least one Alliance that exists in this installation, and this chess piece is not imported.
